notes.title: FUR Squadron v2.0 Update has taken off!
notes.content: [h1]August 29th Update Highlights[/h1][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="l5Xl3s5zLNg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]🐦 New Robin Mode[/h3][h3]🚀 New Playable Ships / New Controls[/h3][h3]🌈 HDR support[/h3][h3]🎮 UI/UX improvements[/h3][h3]🎵 Remastered Soundtrack[/h3][h3]🛠️ Minor gameplay fixes[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h2]🐦 Robin Mode: Erith Robin Joins the Fight[/h2][p]Straight from [b]FUR Squadron Phoenix[/b], Erith Robin brings a bold new challenge. Start each mission with minimal shields and a full payload of guided bombs. Precision and timing are everything. Plus, discover alternate endings hidden in the credits![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🚀 New Ships & Controls[/h2][p]All playable ships now feature the sleek new designs from [b]FUR Squadron Phoenix[/b]. Controls have been reworked with improved physics, and you can now tilt your ship using gamepad analog triggers for more dynamic maneuvering.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🌈 HDR Support[/h2][p]We now support HDR displays! Get ready for brighter highlights, deeper shadows, and colors that really pop.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🎵 Remastered Soundtrack[/h2][p]Every track has been remastered for better clarity and punch on home speakers. Love the music? You can now buy[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751530/FUR_Squadron_Soundtrack/"] the full soundtrack on Steam [/url]and support the team![/p]
